about.title: Aviation, optimization and software, in that order.
body: I'm an aerospace engineer from URJC (Air Navigation, 2018–2026). My thesis, a MILP model solved with Gurobi that generates aircraft rotations with sustainability criteria, was graded 9.5/10. I completed UNIR's Advanced Program in DevOps & Cloud (8.99/10). I'm looking for a backend, optimization or aerospace and air navigation operations team.
about.hobbies: Outside work: Formula 1, the mountains, simulators and 3D printing.

jobs.role: Project Engineer · Airline Operations Planning & Optimization
items: Planning logic of aircraft assignment software used in production by airlines: planning rules, operational data validation and automation of tactical planning.
TAP Air Portugal technical rollout: data integration, business rules, backend services and go-live support.
Python services and REST APIs (Flask, PostgreSQL) tested with Pytest: 85% coverage across the microservices.
Daily operation of AWS production infrastructure for two clients (ECS Fargate, RDS, S3, CloudWatch) and cost inventory.
Aerodynamics design: rear wing with SolidWorks and CFD (Ansys Fluent).

education.note: UNIR own degree (450 h, 18 ECTS), grade 8.99/10. Includes AZ-900 and AWS Cloud Practitioner preparation; it is not a vendor certification.
